selector.rationale: Endometriosis best explains the findings of acute inflammation and foci of endometriosis on biopsy, as well as the patient's history of endometriosis and the presence of a pericecal soft-tissue mass.

rejected.label: Acute Appendicitis
rejected.why: Appendix was not identified during diagnostic laparoscopy and biopsy showed foci of endometriosis

rejected.label: Inverted Appendix
rejected.why: No direct evidence of an inverted appendix and the presence of endometriosis better explains the symptoms

rejected.label: Neoplasm
rejected.why: While a neoplasm is possible, the evidence for endometriosis is stronger and there is no clear indication of a neoplasm
